name: 돌 화로

scope.styleReference: 텍스트 스타일만 사용. 로컬 스타일 파일은 업로드하지 않음.

request.description: Single static game prop: a LOW squat rough STONE BRAZIER, a small thick warm-gray stone basin on a stable short stone base. Clearly defined circular rim opening viewed from above, shallow dark bowl, one or two short split firewood logs INSIDE the basin. A small restrained amber-orange flame centered above the logs is the main color accent. Gray stone, not metal. Calm East Asian mountain-village RPG / HD2D pixel-art prop: muted warm gray and taupe stone, desaturated dark gray-brown timber, broad angular flat color planes, 2-3 tones per material, crisp native pixel clusters, restrained selective colored edges with no heavy black outline, soft upper-left lighting. Front/south facing low-top-down orthographic camera. One full isolated object centered on a TRANSPARENT canvas with comfortable clear margins. No floor, baked cast shadow, text, characters, sprite sheet, noise, dithering, glossy surface, tall pedestal, handles, decorative patterns, huge flames, sparks, smoke, glowing aura or ground ring. Easy recognizable stone fire bowl. Exactly one sprite.
request.name: 돌 화로

capabilities.name: Pro Flash
capabilities.grid_recovery: Creation recovers the pixel grid the model drew with Unzoom. An exact grid is kept; drift of at most one pixel is recovered on the expected grid. Images with a background must fill the canvas, so any other size is redrawn with image-to-pixel-art on the generated box only. Sprites without a background keep their own pixels, centred on the canvas, while the drawn pixel is close to the requested one; coarser or oversized sprites are redrawn. Experimental 16x16 creation always uses image-to-pixel-art. Editing and inpainting start at 32x32 and never use image-to-pixel-art conversion.

edit.reference_image_fit: native dimensions must fit the edit canvas

character.rotation_canvas: Native source padded to a square, minimum 32 pixels, aligned to four pixels.

object.rotation_canvas: Eight views use the square V3 canvas; one direction keeps the native size.

capabilities.style_reference_fit: native dimensions must fit the target canvas; smaller references are centered without resizing

색이 차분하고 불꽃만 작은 주황 강조색으로 보인다.
limitations: 화로의 고른 회색 테두리 때문에 재질이 돌보다 금속처럼 느껴질 여지가 있다.
